profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full stack software engineer with 12 years experience leading teams to build exceptional applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Team lead on multiple internal tools within hardware engineering, built for web, iOS, and iPadOS.
• Responsible for product strategy, roadmaps, stakeholder engagement, application architecture, upgrading frameworks and tools, onboarding and mentoring new engineers, and production support.
• Improved code quality by leading multiple successful TypeScript migrations and introducing numerous code quality tools including Prettier, ESLint, Stylelint, Rubocop, CSpell.
